data.name: WEAPONS FREE
data.detailed_description:
EDITOR'S NOTE(s):

-WEAPONS FREE is intended by the developer to be played with max immersion, but certain features can be changed to approximate a traditional fps experience.

-WEAPONS FREE was made for entertainment and is not intended to inspire real-world violence. "Repay no one evil for evil, but give thought to do what is honorable in the sight of all, and if possible, so far as it depends on you, live peaceably with all" Romans 12:17-18 ESV

GAME STORY:

The United states is crumbling. Nazi ideology has corrupted the government, and the people have begun to rebel. Additionally, word has spread of the increasing danger that the United States poses to the rest of the world, so countries like Ukraine and Germany have been sent to infiltrate the U.S., remove the neo-Nazis from government, and establish a new government that honors the old American Constitution. In WEAPONS FREE you play as Evan Kurtz, the son of a marine who lost his family when the invaders first arrived. The loss of his family drove Evan to be fully dedicated to serving the United States government and its wishes, good or bad. As Evan, you will need to make the choice of whether you will fight with honor or slaughter those who oppose you.

FEATURES:

-Tactical single-player CQB

-Realistic bodycam-style camera effects

-gritty, immersive gunplay

-multiple unique weapons

-Dynamic, challenging AI

-Multiple maps/scenarios

-Honor System where acting morally is rewarded

-Firing range and procedural arena for sandbox play

INSPIRATIONS:

-Call of Duty MW2 2022

-Ready or Not

-Bodycam

-Unrecord (even though it's not even out yet hurry up!)

data.short_description: WEAPONS FREE is a tactical CQB shooter in the bodycam and helmetcam perspectives. This game prioritizes challenging AI, unpredictable scenarios, and immersion. WEAPONS FREE includes realistic combat, true-to-life bodycam, interaction with civilians, and multiple levels with their own unique feel.
